capabilities: Install a plugin from a GitHub, GitLab or Gitea repository URL
Check sideloaded plugins for new releases on request
disambiguation: Not a plugin catalog or browser; it only installs plugins whose repository URL you paste and cannot search or discover plugins yet.
extras: Includes a security disclaimer that users should only install plugins from authors they trust; the 'How it works' section is incomplete and a roadmap lists future features such as a plugin browser and viewing READMEs.
intentEvidence: See also Obsidian42 - BRAT which similarly allows sideloading plugins, but is targeted more at beta-testers
motivation: The author found manual sideloading a drag and wanted a one-click install from a repo URL instead.
problem: Obsidian can only install plugins from the official directory, so plugins distributed elsewhere must be manually downloaded and copied into the vault's .obsidian/plugins folder.

relations.evidence: See also Obsidian42 - BRAT which similarly allows sideloading plugins, but is targeted more at beta-testers

summary: Installer that sideloads Obsidian plugins from GitHub, GitLab or Gitea repository URLs and checks those plugins for updates on demand.
